title: Why Choosing Dinner Feels Impossible 🍕
caption:
By the end of the day, even picking dinner feels impossible.

Every choice costs a little. A famous 2011 study of judges' parole decisions found favorable rulings dropped close to zero before a break (other researchers say case order explains part of it). That's decision fatigue.

Which level of tired are you on right now? 👇
